text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
For the day off, I thank you sincerely! 
Thanks to you, I got an excellent night's 
sleep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's right! How about you, Traniner? 
It's recommended to read a book before bed 
to have a peaceful slumber…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: A textbook!! I'll lend you my copy!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Not only does it prep you for a review, 
but it also puts you to sleep… As expected 
of every honor roll student's bible!

Looks like Sakura Bakushin O got a good 
night's sleep on her day off!
